# Private automatic lexical construction

This is a CPU-qualified private integration profile, not a canonical feature,
hardware deployment, or completed production registration. Earlier adaptive,
admission, page/link, and mixed-root5 releases remain unchanged.

Run from SuperEditor:

```
python3 tests/test_cache_lexical_production.py --auto \
  --fixture build/cache-editor-product/20261026T045019460982Z/fixture
python3 tests/test_cache_lexical_production.py --auto --auto-costs-only \
  --fixture build/cache-editor-product/20261026T045019460982Z/fixture
```

`--auto-faults-only` is the bounded debugging subset. `--build-only` assembles
private outputs. None runs a shared Makefile, modifies canonical assets, or
operates VICE/hardware. The generator pins its released source dependencies and
uses the immutable product source ZIP/report. Generated sources, maps, labels,
and byte hashes are retained in each run directory.

## Trigger and operation residency

The test imports five additional genuine assets at their assigned identities:
C45 gateway, R36 checked resolver, R37 lexical page/roles, C47 actual lexer
producer, and C49 COW linker. The catalog has 59 entries. Existing eplay,
lifecycle, gtype, gfont and line modules keep their meanings. No object or bank
is added for lexical data: new pages use checked unused capacity in the actual
typed `$53` semantic object. This does not solve eventual combined mapped+lexical
production registration; that would use all 64 entries and needs its own cold
metadata, scheduling, lifecycle, and pressure qualification.

1. Real public Markdown rendering establishes a semantic baseline (root flags1,
   lexical ABI0). No host begins a lexical job or supplies a lexical reference.
2. Public `syntax full` invalidates presentation state. Actual C21/C20 requests a
   C25 code window. C25's guarded admission routes Full/job11 windows with whole
   BODY length at least768 to C45. All scalar/source/context checks on the old
   C25 path remain available through explicit opcode3, avoiding recursion.
3. C45 verifies every caller packet byte with an actual counted R14 reader.
   R36 validates root/CR page/header/payload CRCs, full FS59, AUTH13, ticket,
   exact START/BODY/END/language, and supported one-CR-page topology. A genuine
   root1/NIL receipt is repacked into the released producer's receipt ABI after
   releasing that reader. No parser event or reference is fabricated.
4. Actual C47 begins a fresh R14 lease, compares all59 source identity bytes to
   the receipt, and feeds the unchanged BASIC/assembler lexer once per BODY.
   R37 drains each real span before C47 ACK. READY terminal is held until the
   checked page is sealed and its directory entry is VALID.
5. Sequential resident REQUEST/OP scheduling runs C49. It preserves the released
   source-keyed COW CR-page and alternate-root VALID-last algorithm. New roots
   advertise flags5 (`BASE1|LEX4`), lexical ABI1, and per-CR completion/ref/count.
6. C45 restores the verified parent packet after C49's documented8200 CR scratch,
   obtains a fresh reader, and resolves the newly committed root/CR again. Only
   that checked reference drives R37 roles. C21 then paints normally.

C children never nest in the same slot. C47/C49 keep their own OP1 on pending and
relay completed initialization/ACK/link or optional errors to C45. R14/R36/R37
are ordinary C-to-R calls. Preview completion routing is inherited but this
automatic profile's acceptance is source GEOS only; preview is not claimed.

## Private flags and cancellation

The full private flag map is ARMED1, LOST2, MUTATING4, ACTIVE8, existing rebuild
TRIED16, PAGE_PROOF32, **reserved64**, and private lexical-attempt128. Bit128 is
not approved canonical ABI. C45 marks its first eligible attempt per baseline,
including unsupported topology/failure, so later uncompleted windows choose
actual C25 without repeated gateway/construction admission. A root5 CR lacking
completion is a safe miss, not a second construction attempt. Root3/7 mapped
schemas remain unsupported here; they are never treated as root1/5.

Two coupled same-size specializations are required: R19 ignores128 in addition
to16 when checking its strict cached-carry flag mask, and successful R33 fresh
baseline commit clears128. Reserved64 is still rejected. The generator asserts
the original opcode witnesses and exhaustively checks all256 mask inputs. Actual
fresh-source initialization and public R33 baseline commit revocation are tested.
No host clears128 to retry a failed build.

Every live construction/resolver/consumer reader is at BC_FRAME+173 and has
ACTIVE set. Actual resident STOP/error cleanup can restore/end it even if a
worker is missing. Producer and linker BEGIN reject a competing ACTIVE job
before phase/context writes. The held source lease is released before publishing
the real receipt, after terminal ACK, and after the linker. C45 failures release
only its owned reader and fall back to strict C25. Failed/STREAM work may leave
unreferenced candidate bytes, never a new reachable CR/root capability.

## RAM and guards

There is no resident BSS/ZP growth. Producer state uses the released576-byte BC
frame and actual60-byte lexer. C45 control is9096..90EB (after saved FS9040..9095),
with the verified COUNT<=128 packet parked at8F40..8FBF after C20 has stashed its
maps. GSEM0..20 remains immutable. GSEM_USED23 receives only a per-CR completion
advisory after checked classification; it is not authority. The query's complete
root/CR/reference/CRC/source validation still authorizes every hit.

The test snapshots all16MiB. Construction allows only the two actual newly
allocated4096-byte pages, their8-byte directory entries, the actual alternate
root128, and existing precisely declared source FE spans. The old selected root
and all previously reachable pages stay exact. Warm intervals allow no `$53`
writes. STOP/fault intervals permit only observed, checked unreferenced candidate
pages/metadata and an alternate root with unpublished VALID. Canonical source,
pending/history/selection/clipboard, catalog identity, C600..C9FF, and foreign REU
remain exact. Current full FS59 representation identity is intentionally strict:
navigation/W_LOAD identity changes may miss; no content-equivalence relaxation
or A-to-B-to-A reuse claim is made.

## Cost policy and remaining limits

The original256-byte admission was rejected by measurement: cold BODY256 cost
2,630,416 versus1,724,958 packaged instructions; BODY512 cost3,920,104 versus
3,280,310. Final admission is768, where cold construction plus visible windows
cost5,063,856 versus5,213,398 in the measured BASIC case. Final256/512 cases stay
on C25 with identical load counts; their dispatch overhead is1,015/1,657
instructions (about0.06%/0.05%). This is an empirical conservative policy, not a
universal break-even theorem or PAL-cycle/physical-latency claim.

The ordinary1007-ish-byte workloads retain their measured first-render and warm
benefits while counting the complete actual construction/link work. BASIC feeds
998 bytes once; assembler996 once; later retained windows feed neither lexer.
The packaged controls feed18,962/18,924 bytes across the visible windows.

Scope remains first eligible CR per unchanged baseline, one CR page with at most
42 records, and562 lexical spans in one page. Real dense-code STREAM safely
falls back; both candidate and packaged dense fallback need a larger100,000
total-job harness bound than the generic25,000. Actual per-service execution and
input cancellation bounds are unchanged. Source-role IDs are independent of
font/palette settings. No multi-code-block construction policy, edit rebasing,
mapped3/7 coexistence, reduced-REU/native timing, or canonical stack/lifecycle
qualification is claimed by this release.

Before promotion, regenerate all bindings/witnesses against a coherent current
product, register all five assets without displacement, integrate the private
flag policy explicitly, then run combined mapped/classification/incremental,
stack, lifecycle, pressure and native suites. Do not promote an isolated kind
mask or global-flag operand without its matching authority/profile changes.
